title: Go-DAW low-hanging fruit
prompt:
4. MIDI file playback source via meltysynth.MidiFileSequencer. The dependency is already in go.mod, the source/rebuild plumbing pattern is fresh from the sfont work, and it gives you "drop
  a .mid in a folder, pick it on a channel, press play" — a whole demo capability for one new source file plus a file-scan endpoint (the listSoundbanks() pattern copies directly).
  5. Tutorial progress persistence in bytdb. The lesson checker already computes pass/miss counts; the scenes store shows the bytdb pattern. Saving best-per-lesson and showing a checkmark in
  the catalog is mostly wiring.
  6. Metronome/count-in. The tutorial's Listen mode already schedules timed notes; a click track is a trivial oscillator burst on the same clock, and it unblocks the "timing-scored lessons"
  idea later.

  Worth noting but bigger: the WebSocket note channel (latency only matters for remote play), native CoreMIDI input, and pitch bend/mod wheel are all real improvements but each is closer to a
  full session than a quick win.
